question: What consequence is declared for anyone who acts within this diagram?
premises: Someone may act within this diagram.
The speaker declares a response to that action.
The speaker claims to take away everything of that person.
inference: Whoever acts within this diagram will have everything taken away by the speaker.
uncertainties: The identity of the speaker is implied to be the goddess but not named in this verse.
plain_english: Whoever should act within this diagram, I take away all that is his.
